summary: Warps an extracted source quadrilateral into a pinned destination quadrilateral for projection mapping and image correction.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Edge extend behavior: hold, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Extract points define the source area; pin points define the destination area.
Bilinear and perspective mapping differ visibly on oblique quads.
Low Grid Refine values can reveal coarse warp deformation.
Background color appears only where the warp exposes image-free regions.
key_concepts: Corner Pin TOP has two stages: extract a source quad, then pin it into a destination quad.
Extract points are source-space coordinates; pin points are destination-space coordinates.
Each corner has XY values and unit parameters, so units must match the intended coordinate space.
Extraction mapping can be bilinear or perspective, which changes oblique quad behavior.
Grid Refine subdivides the warp to reduce coarse deformation artifacts.
Background color fills regions revealed outside the pinned image.
